name: Cannibalistic Cousins
label: Quest
description: Mystic Yayo'jin of Revantusk Village calls the Vilebranch trolls a depraved lot who prey on other trolls and humanoids. With Zul'jin not there to destroy…
intro: Mystic Yayo'jin of Revantusk Village calls the Vilebranch trolls a depraved lot who prey on other trolls and humanoids. With Zul'jin not there to destroy them, she asks you to destroy their Scalpers and Soothsayers near the temples in the north by northeast.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Three different tribes of trolls inhabit the Hinterlands, friend. That is about as far as the similarities between the tribes extends: We are all trolls and we live in the Hinterlands.
The Vilebranch - aptly named - are a depraved lot; feeding on other trolls and humanoids.
If Zul'jin were here, he would have destroyed the whole lot of them with a flick of his wrist - alas, Zul'jin has not yet returned and we are left to our own devices.
It is up to you to destroy the filth of the region!

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Vilebranch Soothsayers and Scalpers inhabit the north by northeast region of the Hinterlands.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, adventurer. Zul'jin himself could not have done a better job!
